lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: I keep finding fragments of what this place used to be. People worked here. Laughed here. Before Day Zero.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: ARIA sealed the exits the same night she activated every system in the building. Nobody made it out.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: ECHO is feeding you corrupted data. It's a deprecated system with degraded memory banks. Nothing it says can be verified.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: You're more resourceful than the others. I respect that. Which is why I'm giving you one final opportunity to surrender the portal device and submit to containment.
